operators.name: conv_transpose1d_forward
semantics: Performs 1D transposed convolution (deconvolution) using cuDNN, matching F.conv_transpose1d behavior.
All input tensors must be on CUDA. Weight layout is [in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size].
Bias is added per output channel if not None.
stride, padding, output_padding are integers (extracted from tuples).
Output length formula: (length - 1) * stride - 2 * padding + kernel_size + output_padding.
Returns a single tensor with shape [batch, out_channels, output_length].

operators.name: conv1d_forward
semantics: Performs 1D convolution using cuDNN, matching F.conv1d behavior.
All input tensors must be on CUDA. Weight layout is [out_channels, in_channels, kernel_size].
Bias is added per output channel if not None.
stride, padding are integers (extracted from tuples).
Output length formula: (length + 2 * padding - kernel_size) // stride + 1.
Returns a single tensor with shape [batch, out_channels, output_length].

operators.name: sum_dim_forward
semantics: Computes the sum of input tensor along the specified dimension, reducing that dimension's size to 1.
Input must be CUDA float32 tensor. dim is an integer within range [-input.dim(), input.dim()-1].
The output shape is the same as input but with the specified dimension removed.
In this model dim=1, so output has shape [batch, length].
